samples.question: This image shows one small framed box labelled KEY standing alone above a row of five larger framed panels of identical size, numbered 1 to 5 from left to right. Every hub in the image is a filled coloured dot with thin straight spokes radiating outward from it; every spoke is a separate straight line of the same length, and no spoke ever reaches another hub. The KEY box holds exactly one hub and every panel holds exactly three hubs. Hub colour, hub size, spoke length, spoke thickness and hub position are dealt independently of the answer and never carry information. Every one of the five panels holds eleven spokes in total, so hub count, total spoke count and total ink are identical in every panel and can never separate them. A single hub carries between two and six spokes, and the spokes of a hub are always separated by a plainly visible angle, so they can be counted one by one. Neither the direction a spoke points, nor the order of the spokes around a hub, nor the colour of a hub matters: only how many spokes a hub has. Exactly one hub in the five panels carries the same number of spokes as the key hub, and every other hub in the five panels differs from the key hub by at least one spoke. Each of the four panels without that hub still holds at least one hub whose spoke count is within one of the key's, so no panel stands out by holding conspicuously crowded or conspicuously bare hubs. Which numbered panel contains the hub with exactly as many spokes as the key hub? Answer with exactly one of: panel-1, panel-2, panel-3, panel-4, panel-5.
